    {["idx"] = "04", ["text"] = "Download software for key generation", ["col"] = ThemeColors.NEON_AMBER},
    {["idx"] = "05", ["text"] = "Copy the generated key from the software", ["col"] = ThemeColors.NEON_AMBER},
    {["idx"] = "06", ["text"] = "Return here and paste key then [ VERIFY ]", ["col"] = ThemeColors.NEON_BLUE}
}

for i, step in ipairs(StepsData) do
    local state = 0
    local stepFrame, badge
    while true do
        if (state == 1) then
            badge = CreateInstance("Frame", {["Name"] = "Badge", ["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 34), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), ["BackgroundColor3"] = step.col, ["BackgroundTransparency"] = 0.8, ["BorderSizePixel"] = 0, ["ZIndex"] = 15, ["Parent"] = stepFrame})
            CreateUICorner(badge, 4)
            CreateInstance("TextLabel", {["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1, ["Text"] = step.idx, ["TextSize"] = 12, ["Font"] = Enum.Font.Code, ["TextColor3"] = step.col, ["ZIndex"] = 16, ["Parent"] = badge})
            CreateInstance("TextLabel", {["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 0), ["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1, ["Text"] = step.text, ["TextSize"] = 11, ["Font"] = Enum.Font.Code, ["TextColor3"] = ThemeColors.TEXT_BRIGHT, ["TextXAlignment"] = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ["TextWrapped"] = true, ["ZIndex"] = 16, ["Parent"] = stepFrame})
            state = 2
        end
        if (state == 0) then
            stepFrame = CreateInstance("Frame", {["Name"] = "Step" .. i, ["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35), ["BackgroundColor3"] = ThemeColors.BG_INPUT, ["BackgroundTransparency"] = 0, ["BorderSizePixel"] = 0, ["LayoutOrder"] = i, ["ZIndex"] = 14, ["Parent"] = StepsList})
            CreateUICorner(stepFrame, 4)
            state = 1
        end
        if (state == 2) then break end
    end
end

            Animate(CopyBtn, {["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(0, 60, 35)}, 0.15)
            Animate(CopyStroke, {["Transparency"] = 0}, 0.15)
            break
        end
    end
end)

            Animate(CopyStroke, {["Transparency"] = 0.2}, 0.15)

        end
    end
end)

CreateUICorner(LoadingFill, 2)

local CurrentPageIdx = 1
local function SwitchPage(targetIdx)
    local state = 0
    local pages, currentPage, targetPage, targetPos
    while true do
        if (state == 0) then
            pages = {Page1, Page2, Page3}
            currentPage = pages[CurrentPageIdx]
            targetPage = pages[targetIdx]
            targetPage.Visible = true
            state = 1
        end
        if (state == 1) then
            if (targetIdx > CurrentPageIdx) then
                targetPage.Position = UDim2.new(1.2, 0, 0, 20)
            else
                targetPage.Position = UDim2.new(-1.2, 0, 0, 20)
            end
            targetPos = nil
            if (targetIdx > CurrentPageIdx) then
                targetPos = UDim2.new(-1.2, 0, 0, 20)
            else
                targetPos = UDim2.new(1.2, 0, 0, 20)
            end
            Animate(currentPage, {["Position"] = targetPos}, 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            state = 2
        end
        if (state == 2) then
            Animate(targetPage, {["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)}, 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            task.delay(0.4, function()
                if (currentPage and currentPage.Parent) then
                    currentPage.Visible = false
                end
            end)
            CurrentPageIdx = targetIdx
            break
        end
    end
end

GetKeyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchPage(2) end)
BackBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchPage(1) end)

CopyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local state = 0
    while true do
        if (state == 0) then
            pcall(function()
                if setclipboard then setclipboard("https://discord.gg/nexus")
                elseif toclipboard then toclipboard("https://discord.gg/nexus")
                end
            end)
            CopyBtn.Text = "✓  COPIED!"
            state = 1
        end
        if (state == 1) then
            CopyBtn.TextColor3 = ThemeColors.SUCCESS
            Animate(CopyConfirm, {["TextTransparency"] = 0}, 0.15)
            state = 2
        end
        if (state == 2) then
            task.delay(2.5, function()
                if (CopyBtn and CopyBtn.Parent) then
                    CopyBtn.Text = "📋  [ COPY LINK ]"
                    CopyBtn.TextColor3 = ThemeColors.NEON_GREEN
                    Animate(CopyConfirm, {["TextTransparency"] = 1}, 0.5)
                end
            end)
            break
        end
    end
end)

SubmitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local key = KeyInput.Text
    key = key:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if (key == "") then
        DisplayStatusMessage("[ERR] No input detected", ThemeColors.NEON_RED, 3)
        return
    end

    DisplayStatusMessage("[...] Verifying key - please wait", ThemeColors.NEON_AMBER)
    ProgressWrap.Visible = true
    ProgressBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    Animate(ProgressBar, {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)}, 1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
    StatusLabel.Text = "STATUS\n─────────\nVERIFYING..."
    StatusLabel.TextColor3 = ThemeColors.NEON_AMBER
    task.wait(GetRandomRange(1, 1.5))

    local isValid = true
    if isValid then
        local state = 0
        local keySummary, fullLog
        while true do
            if (state == 0) then
                Animate(ProgressBar, {["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)}, 0.3)
                ProgressBar.BackgroundColor3 = ThemeColors.SUCCESS
                DisplayStatusMessage("[OK] Key verified - access granted", ThemeColors.SUCCESS)
                state = 1
            end
            if (state == 1) then
                StatusLabel.Text = "STATUS\n─────────\n+ VERIFIED"
                StatusLabel.TextColor3 = ThemeColors.SUCCESS
                Animate(InputStroke, {["Color"] = ThemeColors.SUCCESS}, 0.2)
                state = 2
            end
            if (state == 2) then
                keySummary = (#key > 8) and (key:sub(1, 8) .. "........") or key
                fullLog = "Key:     " .. keySummary .. "\n"
                state = 3
            end
            if (state == 3) then
                SwitchPage(3)
                task.wait(1)
                TypewriterEffect(Msg, "Authorization complete. Welcome.", 0.03, ThemeColors.NEON_GREEN)
                state = 4
            end
            if (state == 4) then
                fullLog = fullLog .. "User:    " .. LocalPlayer.Name .. "\n"
                fullLog = fullLog .. "Time:    " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") .. "\n"
                fullLog = fullLog .. "Session: " .. GenerateRandomSession()
                TypewriterEffect(Detail, fullLog, 0.01, ThemeColors.TEXT_DIM)
                task.wait(0.3)
                Animate(LoadingFill, {["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)}, 2.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                state = 5
            end
            if (state == 5) then
                local tasks = {"INITIALIZING PAYLOAD...", "LOADING MODULES...", "INJECTING...", "COMPLETE"}
                for i, v in ipairs(tasks) do
                    task.wait(0.6)
                    BarLabel.Text = v
                    if (i == #tasks) then BarLabel.TextColor3 = ThemeColors.SUCCESS end
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
                state = 6
            end
            if (state == 6) then
                Animate(MainWindow, {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 0)}, 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                Animate(Backdrop, {["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1}, 0.35)
                task.wait(0.4)
                ScreenGui:Destroy()
                break
            end
        end
    else
        DisplayStatusMessage("[FAIL] Invalid key - access denied", ThemeColors.ERROR, 3)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    local state = 0
    while true do
        if (state == 0) then
            MainWindow.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            MainWindow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6)
            state = 1
        elseif (state == 1) then
            MainWindow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -3)
            task.wait(0.1)
            state = 2
        elseif (state == 2) then
            Animate(MainWindow, {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 480), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -240)}, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            task.wait(1.5)
            local logEntries = {
                {["text"] = "[SYS] Establishing secure connection...", ["color"] = ThemeColors.TEXT_DIM},
                {["text"] = "[SYS] Protocol: AES-256-GCM", ["color"] = ThemeColors.TEXT_DIM},
                {["text"] = "[SYS] Connected to auth.nexus.io", ["color"] = ThemeColors.NEON_GREEN},
                {["text"] = "[>>>] Awaiting key input...", ["color"] = ThemeColors.NEON_AMBER}
            }
            for i, entry in ipairs(logEntries) do
                local log = AddLogEntry("", entry.color, i)
                TypewriterEffect(log, entry.text, 0.02, entry.color)
                task.wait(0.15)
            end
            break
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent do
        local state = 0
        while true do
            if (state == 0) then
                Animate(MainWindow, {["Transparency"] = 0.3}, 2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                task.wait(2)
                state = 1
            elseif (state == 1) then
                Animate(MainWindow, {["Transparency"] = 0.7}, 2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                task.wait(2)
                state = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)
